name: PersonalIdentifier
label: Personal identifier
description: A unique pseudonymised code or persistent subject identifier assigned to an individual within the study or biobank repository. (NCIT:C164337)

name: GenderAtBirth
label: Gender at birth
description: The gender or biological sex assigned to the individual at birth, typically documented in medical records or official birth certificates. (GSSO:009418)

name: CountryOfResidence
label: Country of residence
description: The sovereign country where the individual primarily resides at the time of study enrolment or sample collection. (NCIT:C224826)

name: Ancestry
label: Ancestry
description: The genetic or geographic ancestral background of an individual, evaluated using ancestry-informative genomic markers or population categories. (NCIT:C176763)

name: CountryOfBirth
label: Country of birth
description: The country in which the individual was born. (GENEPIO:0001094)

name: YearOfBirth
label: Year of birth
description: The year in which the individual person was born. (NCIT:C83164)

name: Status
label: Status
description: The most recent vital or clinical follow-up status of the individual recorded by the biobank or registry (e.g. alive, deceased, lost to follow-up). (NCIT:C166244)

name: AgeAtDeath
label: Age at death
description: In the event of participant decease, the calculated age of the individual at the time of death, measured in completed years. (NCIT:C135383)

name: PrimaryAffiliatedInstitute
label: Primary affiliated institute
description: The primary healthcare facility, clinical centre, or biobank institution responsible for the medical management or enrolment of the individual. (NCIT:C25412)

name: ParticipatesInStudy
label: Participates in study
description: Reference to the study or studies in which this person participates. (RO:0000056)
